rows.label: Bash(for f)
rows.sample: for f in /proc/[0-9]*/status; do awk '/^Name/{n=$2}/^VmSwap/{s=$2}/^VmRSS/{r=$2}END{if(s+r>300000)printf "%8d MB swap %8d MB rss  %s\n",s/1024,r/1024,n}' $f 2>/dev/null; done | sort -rn | head -20; echo ---; ps -eo pid,etime,rss,comm --sort=-rss | head -15; echo ---; df -h -t tmpfs | sort -k3 -h | tail -5
